page.overview:
What is Angalpuk?

Angalpuk, also called the "Eastern Basin", was one of the three regions of the Great Glacier.

Angalpuk was located in the eastern Great Glacier. It was a very flat land with a scattering of mountains and forests.

Angalpuk had more vegetation than any other part of the Great Glacier, with small forests of birch, evergreens and willow. The trees rarely grew as tall as their southern cousins, usually topping out at in height. . The black sled dog, also known as the okteff, was native to Angalpuk.

Average temperatures in Angalpuk ranged from . In the month of Flamerule, temperatures ranged from . During the months of Eleasis through Uktar, they ranged from .
